verdict.rationale: Classifying and splitting multi-document packets is a fair axis for a document-processing product, so it applies, but the evidence pack never shows it. The docs cover OCR, page-level blocks, and annotations of the whole document (`document_annotation`), with nothing on detecting document boundaries, classifying document types, or returning separate per-document results from one upload. The 'multi-document queries' feature is Q&A across already-separate documents, not packet splitting.
